micah.1.p1.b1.text: in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah

micah.1.p1.b2.text: This is the word of the LORD that came to Micah the Moreshite … what he saw regarding Samaria and Jerusalem

micah.1.p1.b3.text: Hear, O peoples, all of you; listen, O earth, and everyone in it!

micah.1.p1.b4.text: For behold, the LORD comes forth from His dwelling place; He will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.

micah.1.p1.b5.text: The mountains will melt beneath Him, and the valleys will split apart, like wax before the fire, like water rushing down a slope.

micah.1.p1.b6.text: What is the transgression of Jacob? Is it not Samaria?

micah.1.p1.b7.text: Therefore I will make Samaria a heap of rubble in the open field … I will pour her stones into the valley and expose her foundations.

micah.1.p1.b8.text: All her carved images will be smashed to pieces

micah.1.p2.b1.text: Because of this I will lament and wail; I will walk barefoot and naked.

micah.1.p2.b2.text: I will howl like a jackal and mourn like an ostrich.

micah.1.p2.b3.text: For her wound is incurable; it has reached even Judah; it has approached the gate of my people, as far as Jerusalem itself.

micah.1.p2.b4.text: Do not tell it in Gath; do not weep at all. Roll in the dust in Beth-leaphrah.

micah.1.p2.b5.text: For the dwellers of Maroth pined for good, but calamity came down from the LORD, even to the gate of Jerusalem.

micah.1.p2.b6.text: Harness your chariot horses, O dweller of Lachish.

micah.1.p2.b7.text: Shave yourselves bald and cut off your hair in mourning for your precious children … as bald as an eagle, for they will go from you into exile.
